function LoadSpot(divid,desktopid,desktopsrc,mobileid,mobilesrc )
{
 var s = document.createElement('script');
    s.type = 'text/javascript';
    s.async = true;

if(screen.availWidth < 1200)
{
//mobile
s.id=mobileid;
s.src =mobilesrc;
}
else
{
//desktop
  s.id=desktopid;
  s.src =desktopsrc;
}

    var x = document.getElementById(divid);
    x.parentNode.insertBefore(s, x);
  }
